<target>## **21.1. D Register State**

The D extension widens the 32 floating-point registers, `f0-f31` , to 64 bits (FLEN=64 in Table 24. The `f` registers can now hold either 32-bit or 64-bit floating-point values as described below in Section 21.2.

_FLEN can be 32, 64, or 128 depending on which of the F, D, and Q extensions are supported. There can be up to four different floating-point precisions supported,_  _including H, F, D, and Q._</target>
